lines.speaker: right
lines.text: Heh... You just sat down at the computer and your hands are already shaking?

lines.speaker: left
lines.text: I'm just a bit nervous. Once the questions appear, I'll be fired up.

lines.speaker: right
lines.text: Prove it. Don't let your mind go blank on the very first question!

lines.speaker: right
lines.text: Hmph... your reflexes are pretty sharp. You're already speeding through the warm-up.

lines.speaker: left
lines.text: One obstacle down. Yet the pressure in this room is only just beginning...

lines.speaker: right
lines.text: Looks like you're getting confident. Let me make all that memorized material feel unfamiliar.

lines.speaker: left
lines.text: Wait... I just read this last night. Why is it suddenly all a blur?!

lines.speaker: right
lines.text: Come on, doubt yourself! Change your answer at the last second!

lines.speaker: right
lines.text: Incredible... even with your memory wavering, your instincts still locked in the right answer!

lines.speaker: left
lines.text: I almost fell for the distractor. I can't lose focus again.

lines.speaker: right
lines.text: Hear the clock ticking? Your caffeine is wearing off, your eyes are burning, and these questions are getting ridiculous.

lines.speaker: left
lines.text: My head's getting heavy... but if I stop thinking now, all that practice will have been for nothing.

lines.speaker: right
lines.text: Give up! Just guess, close your eyes, and pray!

lines.speaker: right
lines.text: Impossible... you can still think clearly under this much pressure?!

lines.speaker: left
lines.text: Whew... take a breath. Just one more step before the final bell.

lines.speaker: right
lines.text: This is the deciding moment, TheO. One small mistake here could erase everything you've fought for.

lines.speaker: left
lines.text: So be it. No matter how absurd the questions get, I won't leave this room with regrets.

lines.speaker: right
lines.text: SHOW ME THAT YOU DESERVE TO PASS TODAY!

lines.speaker: right
lines.text: Time's up... the exam system is locked. You really held on until the very last second.

lines.speaker: left
lines.text: It's over... finally! Whatever happens next, I gave it everything I had!
